quotes.text: Without knowledge sources, the agent is just a chatbot with a personality. It doesn't know anything about your company.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concisely explains why connecting company data is what makes an agent useful.

quotes.text: The agent respects your existing Microsoft 365 permissions. It doesn't get special access. If you add a SharePoint site as a knowledge source, the agent can only return information that the person asking the question is already allowed to see.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clarifies the key security behaviour of Agent Builder agents in plain language.

quotes.text: Just remember, a template is a starting point, not a finished product. The agent is only as useful as the knowledge sources you connect to it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable rule of thumb for using agent templates.

quotes.text: SharePoint grounding requires a proper Microsoft 365 Copilot license. You cannot build an agent that reads from SharePoint in a developer-only tenant or a trial account.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A practical licensing pitfall that catches people during testing.

chapters.title: The creation flow step by step
Agent Builder vs Copilot Studio vs AI Foundry

takeaways: Agent Builder lets business users create declarative agents inside Microsoft 365 Copilot by describing what they need, with no code required.
Knowledge sources such as SharePoint sites and files are what make an agent useful, and the only-use-specified-sources toggle is the main defense against hallucinations.
Move to Copilot Studio only when you need external-facing agents, non-Microsoft 365 data sources or agentic actions; AI Foundry is for professional developers.
hook: Everyone talks about AI agents, but do you need to be a developer to build one? This episode explains Microsoft Agent Builder for business users and IT pros: how to create an agent from a sentence, connect knowledge sources, respect permissions and know when to step up to Copilot Studio or AI Foundry.
